select b.swjg_mc,b.swjg_dm,b.swjg_jc,a.jsmode_set as jsms,a.zgswry_dm_set as zgyDm, a.flgl_set as flgldj,a.zsjg_dm_set as zsswjgDm from sys_cfg_czry_fpgl a ,dm_swjg b where a.swjg_dm=b.swjg_dm and b.qybz='Y' and a.czry_dm = #{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select t.id,t.czry_dm as czryDm,aa.czry_mc as czryMc,t.swjg_dm as swjgDm, t.zgswry_dm_set as zgswryDm, t.qybz,decode(t.qybz,'Y','是','否') as qybzMc, t.limit_sc as limitSc,t.limit_wm as limitWm,t.limit_qt as limitQt, t.cnt_sc as cntSc,t.cnt_wm as cntWm,t.cnt_qt as cntQt, t.zsjg_dm_set as zsjgDm,(select wm_concat(cc.swjg_jc) from dm_swjg cc where instr(t.zsjg_dm_set,cc.swjg_dm) > 0 ) as zsjgMc, t.flgl_set as flgl,(select wm_concat(dname) from sys_dict a where instr(t.flgl_set,a.dcode) > 0 and a.dtype='flglcd') as flglMc, t.jsmode_set as jsMode,(select wm_concat(dname) from sys_dict b where instr(t.jsmode_set,b.dcode) > 0 and b.dtype='js_mode') as jsModeMc from sys_cfg_czry_fpgl t inner join dm_czry aa on ( aa.czry_dm=t.czry_dm
and aa.swjg_dm like #{swjgDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
) where 1=1
and t.czry_dm = #{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and t.zsjg_dm_set like '%' || #{zsjgDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
and (t.flgl_set = #{flgl,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t.flgl_set like '%' || #{flgl,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%' or t.flgl_set is null)
and (t.jsmode_set = #{jsMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t.jsmode_set like '%' || #{jsMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%' or t.jsmode_set is null)
select a.rolecode as ROLE_DM,a.rolename as ROLE_MC from sys_role a,sys_user_role b,sys_user u where a.rolecode=b.rolecode and u.id=b.czyid and u.czry_dm= #{czryDm} and a.isvalid='1'
select a.swjg_dm,a.swjg_dm_sj from dm_swjg a,dm_czry b where a.swjg_dm=b.swjg_dm and b.czry_dm=#{czryDm} and a.qybz='Y'
